scenarios.title: A｜饮食
scenarios.setting: 玩家和朋友一起吃饭，对方对玩家的一些饮食习惯感到好奇。

turns.text: Do people usually share dishes in China, or does everyone order their own?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: It depends, but sharing dishes is very common.

feedback.naturalExpression: It depends, but sharing dishes is very common.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: When I eat with family or friends, we usually order several dishes and share them.

feedback.naturalExpression: When I eat with family or friends, we usually order several dishes and share them.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: In a lot of situations, the dishes go in the middle and everyone takes what they want.

feedback.naturalExpression: In a lot of situations, the dishes go in the middle and everyone takes what they want.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: People do both. It really depends on the restaurant and the situation.

feedback.naturalExpression: People do both. It really depends on the restaurant and the situation.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: In China, everyone always shares food.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: It depends, but sharing dishes is very common.
feedback.explanation: 太绝对

turns.text: Oh, so you don’t necessarily order one main dish for each person?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Right. We often order a few different dishes for the whole table.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right. We often order a few different dishes for the whole table.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Exactly. That way, everyone gets to try a little of everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. That way, everyone gets to try a little of everything.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Sometimes we do order individually, but sharing is pretty common.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sometimes we do order individually, but sharing is pretty common.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I actually like that. You get to try more things.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Yeah, that’s one of the things I like about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s one of the things I like about it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Exactly. It’s especially nice when you’re eating with a group.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. It’s especially nice when you’re eating with a group.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜节日 / 生活方式
scenarios.setting: 在“解释自己的文化习惯”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“节日 / 生活方式”。

turns.text: What’s the biggest holiday in China?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Chinese New Year is probably the most important traditional holiday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Chinese New Year is probably the most important traditional holiday.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Spring Festival is a really big one, especially for families.

feedback.naturalExpression: Spring Festival is a really big one, especially for families.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: There are several important holidays, but Chinese New Year is probably the best known.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are several important holidays, but Chinese New Year is probably the best known.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: For my family, Chinese New Year is definitely the biggest one.

feedback.naturalExpression: For my family, Chinese New Year is definitely the biggest one.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: A lot of people travel home to spend time with their families.

feedback.naturalExpression: A lot of people travel home to spend time with their families.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Families usually get together and have a big meal.

feedback.naturalExpression: Families usually get together and have a big meal.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Traditions vary from family to family, but spending time together is a big part of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Traditions vary from family to family, but spending time together is a big part of it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We usually have a family dinner and stay up pretty late on New Year’s Eve.

feedback.naturalExpression: We usually have a family dinner and stay up pretty late on New Year’s Eve.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Sometimes, but giving red envelopes with money is a well-known tradition.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sometimes, but giving red envelopes with money is a well-known tradition.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Children often receive red envelopes from older family members.

feedback.naturalExpression: Children often receive red envelopes from older family members.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It depends on the family. Mine doesn’t really exchange regular gifts.

feedback.naturalExpression: It depends on the family. Mine doesn’t really exchange regular gifts.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yeah, although it’s a little different from exchanging Christmas presents.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, although it’s a little different from exchanging Christmas presents.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜对方产生误解
scenarios.setting: 聊天时，对方根据自己听说过的内容，对玩家的文化习惯产生了误解。

turns.text: So do you have to go home for Chinese New Year every year?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Not necessarily. It’s common, but it’s not something everyone has to do.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not necessarily. It’s common, but it’s not something everyone has to do.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: A lot of people do, but everyone’s situation is different.

feedback.naturalExpression: A lot of people do, but everyone’s situation is different.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It’s an important family holiday, but that doesn’t mean everyone celebrates it the same way.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s an important family holiday, but that doesn’t mean everyone celebrates it the same way.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I usually go home, but some of my friends don’t.

feedback.naturalExpression: I usually go home, but some of my friends don’t.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yes, all Chinese people have to go home.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not necessarily. It’s common, but it’s not something everyone has to do.
feedback.explanation: 过度概括

turns.text: Oh, I thought pretty much everyone did.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I can see why you’d think that, but there’s a lot of variation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can see why you’d think that, but there’s a lot of variation.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It’s definitely common, but it’s not a rule.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s definitely common, but it’s not a rule.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s probably the image people see most often, but real life is a bit more complicated.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s probably the image people see most often, but real life is a bit more complicated.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It’s kind of like any holiday—different families have different traditions.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s kind of like any holiday—different families have different traditions.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: That makes sense. I guess I was generalizing a little.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That’s okay. It’s hard to know these things if you haven’t experienced them yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. It’s hard to know these things if you haven’t experienced them yourself.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yeah, that’s why it’s interesting to talk about this stuff.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s why it’s interesting to talk about this stuff.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Feel free to ask me if you’re curious about anything else.

feedback.naturalExpression: Feel free to ask me if you’re curious about anything else.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
